question: Choose the correct one-word substitute for a temporary break or gap in continuity.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Hiatus**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Hiatus"** refers to a temporary pause or gap in continuity, especially in a sequence or process. (अंतराल)

 
 
• **Example:** After working tirelessly for months, she took a hiatus from her job to focus on her health.
 
 
 
• In this context, the word **"Hiatus"** perfectly matches the idea of a temporary break or gap in continuity. 
 
 
• **Example:** The television show went on hiatus during the holiday season.
 
 
 
• Hence, **"Hiatus"** is the correct answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Hiatus**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Interval **(अंतराल): A period of time between two events or activities.

 
 
• **Example:** There was a short interval between the two acts of the play.
 
 
 
• **Pause **(विराम): A temporary stop or rest during an activity.
 
 
• **Example:** He paused for a moment before answering the question.
 
 
 
• **Breach **(उल्लंघन): A violation or break of a rule, law, or agreement.
 
 
• **Example:** There was a breach in security at the airport last night.
